ui-identities.footer: Model and reasoning effort are set in the model tag at the top of each conversation; the working folder is chosen when you create a session, or registered below.
ui-identities.form.label: Display name
ui-identities.form.model: Model (optional; the CLI's configuration by default)
ui-identities.form.note: Sign in official subscription accounts with "+ Sign in with an official account" (the credentials live in {product}'s managed folder). Third-party models must be compatible with Claude Code's API and tool protocol.
ui-identities.form.slotsIntro: Model slots (optional): Claude Code and its subagents choose a model by opus / sonnet / haiku / fable; fill in the model each slot really uses, or leave it empty for Claude Code's default.

ui-identities.intro: Each profile is one sign-in to one harness: an official subscription sign-in, an API key, or the CLI already signed in on this machine. You pick one when you create a session.

ui-identities.kind.managed: Own account: the credentials live only in {product}'s managed folder
